image_description: A side-profile view of a large American Bison standing on a dirt path. The bison has a massive, shaggy dark brown forequarter with a prominent shoulder hump and a beard. The hindquarters are less furry and darker. Four legs are visible, ending in hooves. A short tail with a tuft is visible. In the background, there is a grassy field with other bison grazing.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large broad head with short curved horns.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The head is clearly visible in profile. It is large and broad relative to the body. Short, curved horns are distinctly visible protruding from the top of the head.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Beard of long hair on chin and throat.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: A distinct mass of long, shaggy hair hangs from the chin and throat area, matching the description of a bison beard.
The eye is visible on the side of the head facing the camera and appears dark/black, consistent with the species.
The ears are not prominently sticking out; they appear small and are largely obscured by the thick fur of the head and poll, which is characteristic of bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Massive body with exceptionally tall, heavily built proportions at the withers.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The animal exhibits a massive, heavy build. The withers (shoulder area) are significantly higher than the hips, creating the characteristic sloping back of a bison.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Shaggy dark brown fur covering forequarters forming prominent shoulder hump.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: There is a very clear texture contrast between the front and back. The forequarters are covered in thick, shaggy dark brown fur that forms a high, rounded hump.
The rear half of the body has much shorter, smoother hair compared to the front, revealing the underlying muscle structure more clearly.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Short horns compared to body size.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The horns are relatively small and curved, appearing proportionally short compared to the massive bulk of the head and body.
All four legs are visible and appear sturdy/columnar. The feet end in dark, split structures consistent with cloven hooves.
The tail is visible hanging down behind the hind legs. It is relatively short and ends in a distinct, darker bushy tuft of hair.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification (American Bison vs. European Bison or other bovids) and ensure high-level semantic alignment.
To verify the structural integrity of the four legs and the connection of the limbs to the massive torso, ensuring no fusion or extra limbs.
To check for edge bleeding between the shaggy fur and the background, and to ensure the 'beard' and 'hump' are topologically connected to the main body.
To assess overall image sharpness, lighting consistency, and detect any subtle texture anomalies in the fur or ground.

focus_areas: Fur texture transition between forequarters and hindquarters
Edge sharpness around the shaggy beard and hump
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the transition zone between the shaggy front fur and the smooth rear hide. AI often blurs this boundary unnaturally. Also, verify that the hooves are distinct and not 'melted' into the dirt path. Check if the background bison show any signs of structural collapse or repetition artifacts.
